method: Computer Use with actual browser form controls, incorrect and correct credentials, file chooser, authenticated import, sign out, browser history, and repeat sign in.

checks.observed: The root redirected to /login and displayed the sign-in form.
Password input began masked; Show changed it to text and Hide restored masking.
A wrong password stayed on /login and displayed a generic incorrect-credentials message.
The configured credentials opened the dashboard, identified admin, and retained 50 current events and 4 negative balance rows.
Real review_correction.csv selection and publication accepted 1 revision with 4 changed daily rows.
Sign out returned to /login and removed access to the authenticated workspace.
Back returned to /login with no inventory dashboard DOM restored.

checks.scenario: Sign in again and retain data
checks.observed: A second sign-in retained 54 versions and ITEM-A/WH-A closing 85.000; the next sign-out returned to the masked login form without document-level overflow at 1280 CSS pixels.

limitations: Executed on macOS in the in-app browser. HTTP security and time boundaries have separate automated tests.
An isolated test database was used; the existing local review database was preserved.
